title: Assisting More Seniors to Make Lasting Power of Attorney
what_it_is: Assisting More Seniors to Make Lasting Power of Attorney

sections.label: LPA application fee waived
sections.summary: The $75 application fee for filing an LPA was waived.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: First, we waived the $75 application fee for filing an LPA.

sections.label: Fee waiver and OPGO e-service
sections.summary: Nearly 95% of 153,000 Singaporeans who registered LPAs benefited from the fee waiver, and a new OPGO e-service launches on 14 November 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Nearly 95% of the 153,000 Singaporeans who have registered their LPAs, benefited from the fee waiver.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Second, we will be launching a new Office of Public Guardian Online, or OPGO, e-service on 14 November 2022, so that it is even easier to make an LPA.

sections.label: LPA and ACP outreach campaign
sections.summary: The Office of the Public Guardian and AIC will run a publicity and outreach campaign from 2023 to 2025 encouraging Singaporeans, especially those aged 50 and above, to make LPAs and Advance Care Plans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The Office of the Public Guardian and the Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) will run a publicity and outreach campaign from 2023 to 2025 to encourage Singaporeans, especially those aged 50 and above, to make their LPAs and Advance Care Plans.

sections.label: Fee waiver eligibility clarification
sections.summary: The Member asked the Minister whether there are plans to waive fees, noting Singaporeans are eligible for the fee waiver until 31 March 2023.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hany Soh (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: The first is in relation to the fee waiver.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hany Soh (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: I wish to clarify with the Minister whether there are plans to waive the fees, because currently, Singaporeans are eligible for the fee waiver until 31 March 2023.

sections.label: Fee waiver extension study
sections.summary: Fees recover cost, the waiver was extended so fees are not a barrier to taking up an LPA, and the fee waiver will be studied for extension if necessary.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The fees that we impose are just to recover cost.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We have extended the waiver to make the fee not become a barrier to taking up an LPA.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: There is also the sense that we can postpone this as late as possible, and therefore, we do have to do more, particularly to raise awareness, the importance of having the LPA in place as soon as we can.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: But, having said that, we will certainly study to extend the fee waiver, if necessary, and also to facilitate the take-up of LPA.
